summary: 127.0.0.1:8078 (Shopify) shows 5 addressable product-discovery gap(s), led by search has no typo tolerance. Incumbent discovery: None detected. Strong fit for a tailored Constructor.io walkthrough.

findings.title: Search has no typo tolerance
findings.detail: "jacket" returns results but the misspelling "jakcet" returns nothing. Roughly 1 in 10 search queries contain a typo; today those shoppers hit a dead end.
findings.recommendation: Constructor applies typo tolerance, plurals and synonyms automatically so "jakcet" resolves to the same products as "jacket".
findings.example: In testing we observed: Query "jacket" → ~3 results.

findings.title: No autosuggest / typeahead detected
findings.detail: We found no autosuggest/typeahead wiring on the search box. Autosuggest is where a large share of search revenue is captured — shoppers convert on suggested products and terms before submitting.
findings.recommendation: Constructor Autosuggest adds product previews, trending and recovery suggestions in the typeahead, typically lifting search-led conversion.
findings.example: In testing we observed: Homepage: http://127.0.0.1:8078.

findings.title: Thin or missing faceted navigation
findings.detail: The category/search listing shows little or no faceted filtering (price, color, size, brand). On large catalogs, weak facets force shoppers to scroll endlessly and abandon.
findings.recommendation: Constructor Browse auto-enriches product attributes into rich, rankable facets so shoppers can narrow large catalogs instantly.
findings.example: In testing we observed: Listing page: http://127.0.0.1:8078/collections/jackets.

findings.title: No recommendation pods detected
findings.detail: We found no recommendation modules ('you may also like', 'customers also bought', 'complete the look') on the homepage or product page. Recs are one of the highest-ROI discovery surfaces for AOV.
findings.recommendation: Constructor Recommendations adds revenue-optimized pods to PDP, cart and homepage, driving units-per-order and AOV lift.
findings.example: In testing we observed: Pages checked: homepage, product.

findings.title: No visible personalization
findings.detail: No signs of personalized merchandising ('recommended for you', 'because you viewed'). Discovery is one-size-fits-all, so returning shoppers see the same generic ranking as first-time visitors.
findings.recommendation: Constructor Personalization reranks search, browse and recs per shopper in real time off behavioral signals.
evidence: No personalization markers found across crawled pages
findings.example: In testing we observed: No personalization markers found across crawled pages.
